commands.title: Agent capabilities
commands.selected: Command selected. Fill its parameters, then use Send to run it.
commands.parameters_invalid: Complete valid command parameters before sending. Choose a native model; skill arguments are limited to 4096 characters.
commands.catalog_stale: The native catalog changed. Dismiss and discover commands again; nothing was resent.
commands.model_selection_hint: Selection stays unchanged across search pages. Use Send to apply it to subsequent requests, not already-running work.
commands.changed: The editor or target changed. Select a command again, or dismiss to send ordinary text.
commands.completed: Control operation completed. This does not mean a native turn finished; feedback appears in this conversation.
commands.accepted: Native acceptance confirmed. Outcome is still pending or unconfirmed; check the original request without resending.
commands.noop: The native operation confirmed no effect.
commands.failed: The agent command failed. No automatic retry was sent.
commands.unsupported: This capability is not supported by the agent.
commands.unknown: Outcome unconfirmed. Do not resend; check the original request or conversation.
commands.metadata: Discovery only — execution is not connected.
commands.cancel: Dismiss UI / new command (does not stop native work)

placeholder: A kind word warms the heart; a harsh word wounds it.
